plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked short-term vs long-term synaptic architecture diagram from Eric Kandel & Craig Bailey (1983 Science 220: 91–93 & 2000 Nobel Lecture) shows 1 training pulse causing temporary cAMP/glutamate enhancement across 1,300 existing terminals (short-term memory, minutes) vs 4–5 spaced training pulses activating CREB gene transcription to grow ~2,600 physical terminals (long-term memory, weeks).

teach_overlay.scale: learning something for the rest of your life literally changes the physical anatomy of your brain — sprouting twice as many microscopic bridges between the nerve cells that carry that memory
